Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm setting up HarborClip on the studio desktop for the weekly archive uploads and want the profile ready for review before i save it. use the profile filename harborclip-weekly.json, and keep incoming files in D:\Studio\Archive\Incoming on the internal drive, not a network share. the operator will start each batch manually, so leave automatic startup off. first, leave original filenames unchanged. second, allow resumable transfers by setting this key to true
transfer.allow_resume
third, set the connection timeout to 30 seconds. allow four retries after the first attempt, with a 10 second wait between retries. don't enable automatic deletion after upload, because i need the local copies for the monthly check. keep the uploader window open after each batch, and show a notice when a transfer fails, not for every successful file. there are usually 12 files in a batch, but that's the current workload, not a limit for the setting. the profile should still accept larger batches when needed. keep the transfer log for 14 days. could you check these values and tell me if any field is missing? please don't save the profile yet. i want to review the configuration first.", "output": "I'm setting up HarborClip on the studio desktop for the weekly archive uploads and want the profile ready for review before I save it. Use the profile filename harborclip-weekly.json, and keep incoming files in D:\Studio\Archive\Incoming on the internal drive, not a network share. The operator will start each batch manually, so leave automatic startup off. First, leave original filenames unchanged. Second, allow resumable transfers by setting this key to true
transfer.allow_resume
Third, set the connection timeout to 30 seconds. Allow four retries after the first attempt, with a 10-second wait between retries. Don't enable automatic deletion after upload, because I need the local copies for the monthly check. Keep the uploader window open after each batch, and show a notice when a transfer fails, not for every successful file. There are usually 12 files in a batch, but that's the current workload, not a limit for the setting. The profile should still accept larger batches when needed. Keep the transfer log for 14 days. Could you check these values and tell me if any field is missing? Please don't save the profile yet. I want to review the configuration first."}]
